name: molted
description: Wire Molted (agent-native email infrastructure) into an agent you're building: send/reply/read-inbox MCP tools, REST reference, and safe-default setup guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Give the agent you're building a real inbox
interface.longDescription: Send, reply, read and classify email from an agent you're building, with rate limits, suppressions, consent checks and prompt-injection screening built in. You sign in with your Molted account and choose which mailboxes the plugin can read or send from.
defaultPrompt: Use Molted to read my test inbox and summarize the new replies.
Use Molted to add email sending to the agent I'm building.
